description: Branch R-FMT-2 Text grammar / R-SORT-3 UTF-16 boundaries (stored units) on a ACCDB. TU(ID Long, K Text(255), M Memo): eleven values as counted BSTR units (embedded NUL, a lone high and a lone low surrogate, a lone surrogate between letters, a pair, a reversed pair, a leading U+FEFF, U+0001, 254 letters plus a lone high surrogate, 253 letters plus a pair, letters around a pair) written into both K and M through a table recordset. Reads back what the stored units are, which the display could not show: LEN, and AscW of units 1 to 3 through SQL, and the values through a recordset. Asks whether ACE stores each unit sequence as given (lone surrogates, NUL), and how LEN counts them.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE TU (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TU PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255), M MEMO)
SELECT ID, LEN(K), AscW(Mid(K, 1, 1)), IIf(LEN(K) >= 2, AscW(Mid(K, 2, 1)), Null), IIf(LEN(K) >= 3, AscW(Mid(K, 3, 1)), Null), LEN(M), AscW(Mid(M, 1, 1)) FROM TU ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, K, M FROM TU ORDER BY ID
